aiCommit.configuration.general.title: General
aiCommit.configuration.git.title: Git
aiCommit.configuration.openai.title: OpenAI Compatible
aiCommit.command.aiCommit.title: AI Commit - Generate commit message
aiCommit.config.diffSource.description: Which git changes to use for generation: auto (prefer staged, fallback to unstaged), staged, unstaged, or staged+unstaged.
aiCommit.config.referenceGitLog.descript: Include recent git commit history (git log --oneline) as additional context for the model.
aiCommit.config.gitLogCount.description: How many recent commits to include from git log (max 50).
aiCommit.config.gitLogAuthorScope.descri: Which authors' commits to include in git log context.
aiCommit.config.useGitmoji.description: Whether to include Gitmoji in generated commit messages.
aiCommit.config.openaiBaseUrl.descriptio: OpenAI-compatible Base URL (optional). Should end with /v1 (e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1).
aiCommit.config.openaiModel.description: OpenAI-compatible model. You can select a model from the list by running the 'Show Available OpenAI Models' command
aiCommit.config.systemPrompt.description: Custom system prompt for generating commit messages
aiCommit.config.systemPromptMode.descrip: How to apply the custom system prompt.
aiCommit.config.systemPromptMode.enum.ap: Append after the built-in system prompt
aiCommit.config.scmInputBehavior.descrip: When generating with AI, how to use the commit message input box.
aiCommit.config.scmInputBehavior.enum.co: Use the input box content as additional context/constraints (for example, if you want the AI-generated commit message to include a Bug ID, you can first enter the Bug ID in the input box, and the AI will generate content based on the entered information).
aiCommit.config.openaiTemperature.descri: OpenAI-compatible temperature setting (0-2). Higher values make output more random, lower values more deterministic.
aiCommit.config.openaiExtraBody.descript: Extra OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions request body parameters. Must be a JSON object. Example: {"reasoning_split":true}
